DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 待ち合わせの場所をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for your meeting place?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。家族に「少し先」と言いましたが、どこかわからないそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 曖昧な距離の集合案内を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I told my family it was “a little further ahead,” but they say they don't know where that is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for advice about meeting directions with an unclear distance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 見える目印はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is there a landmark you can see?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 案内板があります。距離より、この板の近くと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 案内板を目印に選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: There is an information board. Instead of giving a distance, I'll tell them I'm near this board.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose the information board as a landmark. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 入口が複数あるので、板の表示も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: There are several entrances, so please check what the board says too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そうですね。入口の名前を読んで送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 複数入口の名称を確認して連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: You're right. I'll read the entrance name and send it to them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check and communicate the names of the multiple entrances. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご家族は移動中ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Is your family on the move?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 止まって待っています。私が迎えに行く方がよさそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族停止中なので迎えを選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: They've stopped and are waiting. It seems better for me to go and meet them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose to go and meet your family because they have stopped. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今いる場所は聞けていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Have you been able to ask where they are now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 入口の写真が届きました。案内板の表示と比べてから迎えに行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家族写真と案内表示を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: They sent a photo of the entrance. I'll compare it with the information board before going to meet them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Compare your family's photo with the information signs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 案内図で入口を確かめてください。違う場所へ案内しないよう、写真と表示を合わせましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16205-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check the entrance on the map. Let's match the photo and the signs so you don't direct them somewhere else.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 遅れについてのお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about the delay?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。迎えを頼んでいます。表示の時刻を到着確定として送ってよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 表示時刻を確定到着として送れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I've asked someone to pick me up. Can I send the displayed time as a confirmed arrival time?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can send the displayed time as a confirmed arrival time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 見込みなので、今後変わる可能性があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: It's an estimate, so it may change later.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では、今は遅れているとだけ伝え、動き出してからもう一度連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 遅延連絡と発車後再連絡を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then for now I'll just say we're delayed, and contact them again once we start moving.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Separate the delay notification from contacting them again after departure. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 迎える方も出発を待てますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Can the person picking you up wait before setting out too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 待てます。駅まで来てもらう前に、連絡する約束にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 迎え側の出発待機を調整する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I'll arrange to contact them before they come to the station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Arrange for the person picking you up to wait before leaving. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 運行案内を引き続きご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please keep checking the service information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。見込みが変わったら、古いメッセージをそのままにしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 古い見込み情報を更新すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. If the estimate changes, I won't leave the old message uncorrected.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will update outdated estimated information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご家族はどちらの駅で待ちますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: At which station will your family wait?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 到着駅です。出発駅へ来る話ではないと、駅名も書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 迎えの駅を明示して誤解を防ぐ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: The arrival station. I'll include the station name to make clear I'm not asking them to come to the departure station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Specify the pickup station to prevent a misunderstanding. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 見込みと確定を分けてお伝えください。新しい案内が出ましたら表示をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please distinguish estimates from confirmed information when telling them. Check the display when new information is issued.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご希望の時間帯はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a preferred time slot?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昼休みにしたいです。休憩は一時間ですが、相談時間だけで考えてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 休憩一時間内の相談予約を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to come during my lunch break. My break is one hour; can I consider just the consultation time?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about booking a consultation within a one-hour break. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 移動や受付の時間も必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: You'll need time for travel and reception too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうですね。往復に時間がかかるので、一時間では足りないかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 移動込みでは不足の可能性を認める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: You're right. The round trip takes time, so one hour might not be enough.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that the time may be insufficient when travel is included. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 別の日や時間帯を検討されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Would you consider another day or time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 半日休める日があります。その日の候補を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 半休可能日の候補を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: There's a day when I can take half a day off. I'd like to know the options for that day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for options on a day when you can take half a day off. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 予約できる枠を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check the available appointment slots.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。先に職場へ休みを確認してから、枠を決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 職場確認後に枠を選ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I'd like to confirm my time off with work first, and then choose a slot.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will choose a slot after checking with work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今は空き状況だけのご確認ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: So for now you're only checking availability?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。予約成立とは思わず、候補を持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 候補照会と予約成立を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll take the options home without assuming an appointment has been booked.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish asking about options from having a confirmed booking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 候補をご案内します。勤務の調整ができたら、予約の申込みをお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll tell you the options. Once you've arranged things with work, please apply for an appointment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 会計の書類でご不明な点がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there something you don't understand about the payment documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族へ何をしたか説明したいのですが、領収書ではよくわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 領収書だけでは治療説明が不明と相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to explain to my family what was done, but I can't really tell from the receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the receipt alone does not make the treatment clear. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 領収書はお支払いの書類です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: The receipt is a payment document.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では、金額の欄から診療内容を自分で推測しない方がよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 金額から内容を推測しないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I shouldn't try to infer the details of my care from the amounts listed, should I?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will not infer the care details from the amounts. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 内容については担当へ確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can check the details with the person responsible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。家族に渡すためではなく、まず自分が理解したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家族共有前に本人理解を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please help me do that. Rather than getting something to give my family, I first want to understand it myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Express a wish to understand personally before sharing with family. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: どの説明をもう一度聞きたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Which explanation would you like to hear again?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 検査の名前です。似た言葉が二つあり、どちらを受けたか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 似た検査名の区別を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: The name of the test. There are two similar terms, and I'd like to confirm which one I had.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to distinguish between similar test names. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 検査担当への確認をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll direct you to the staff responsible for the tests to check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。領収書は捨てず、検査の説明とは分けて保管します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 支払書類と内容説明を分けて保管する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I won't throw the receipt away; I'll keep it separately from the explanation of the test.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep payment documents separate from the explanation of the care. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 領収書をお持ちのまま、担当へお進みください。検査名の確認とお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take your receipt with you and go to the person responsible. I'll tell them you want to confirm the test name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: なくした場所はおわかりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you know where you lost it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 公園か駅です。どちらか一つに決めて書く必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二候補の紛失場所を届けられるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Either the park or the station. Do I have to choose just one to write down?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can report two possible places of loss. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: わかっている範囲で、候補をお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please give the possible locations as far as you know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 公園では帽子を持っていました。駅を出た時にはありませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 最後の所持と紛失発見の場所を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I had my hat in the park. When I left the station, it was gone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State where you last had the item and where you noticed it missing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その間の移動経路も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll also check the route you took between them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 歩いて移動しました。店へは入っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 移動経路と立寄りの有無を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I walked. I didn't go into any shops.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain your route and whether you stopped anywhere. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Does it have any distinctive features?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 灰色で、内側に名前を書いています。外からは見えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 帽子の内側目印を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: It's gray, and I've written my name inside. You can't see it from the outside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Describe the identifying mark inside the hat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 内側の目印も記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll record the mark on the inside too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。公園で落としたと断定せず、二か所と間の道を伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 特定場所を断定せず範囲で申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. Rather than saying definitely that I dropped it in the park, I'd like to report the two places and the road between them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report an area without asserting one specific place. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容でお伺いします。最後に持っていた時点と、なくなったと気づいた時点を記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll take your report on that basis. We'll record when you last had it and when you noticed it was missing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 不在票のお問い合わせでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you calling about a missed-delivery notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。宛名は母ですが、電話するのは私です。先に伝えた方がよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 宛名本人と問合せ者の相違を申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It's addressed to my mother, but I'm the one calling. Should I explain that first?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that the addressee and the person making the inquiry are different. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 宛名とお問い合わせの方を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll check the addressee and the person making the inquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 母は家にいますが、日本語の電話が難しいので手伝っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 母の電話補助という役割を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: My mother is at home, but phone calls in Japanese are difficult for her, so I'm helping.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you are helping your mother with the call. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご本人の確認が必要な場合もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We may need to verify her identity in some cases.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: その時は母に代わります。私が本人だとは言いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人確認時の電話交代を申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: In that case I'll put my mother on. I won't say that I'm the addressee.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Offer to hand the phone over for identity verification. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 配達希望はお母様と相談済みですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you discussed the preferred delivery time with your mother?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだです。空いている候補を聞いてから、母と決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 日時を母と未相談と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not yet. I'd like to hear the available options and then decide with her.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you have not yet discussed the date and time with your mother. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今は希望日時の確定ではありませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: So you aren't confirming a preferred date and time now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。候補をメモして、母に確認した後で申し込みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 候補確認後の本人相談と申込みを述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: That's right. I'll note the options and apply after checking with my mother.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will consult the addressee and apply after checking the options. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: まずお荷物の情報をご確認ください。ご本人とご相談の上、再配達のお申込みへお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: First, please check the parcel information. Consult the addressee before proceeding to request redelivery.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: カードは読み取れませんでしたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: まだ試していません。目印のシールがはがれてきたので、相談に来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未試行カードの目印剥離を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I haven't tried it yet. The identifying sticker is starting to peel off, so I came to ask about it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about a peeling identifying sticker on a card you have not tried. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの部分に貼ってありますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 表側の端です。自分でテープを重ねる前に、扱いを聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 貼付位置と補修前の意図を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: At the edge of the front. I want to ask how to handle it before putting tape over it myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain where the sticker is and why you are asking before repairing it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当がカードの状態を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person responsible will check the condition of the card.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。無理に剥がして表面を傷めたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 強引な剥離を避けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I don't want to damage the surface by forcing the sticker off.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to avoid forcibly peeling it off. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 別のカードにも同じ印を付けていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you put the same mark on any other cards?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: いいえ、この一枚だけです。家族のカードには触っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 対象一枚と他人カード未操作を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: No, only this one. I haven't touched my family's cards.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the single affected card from other people's cards you have not handled. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: カードをそのままお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please show us the card just as it is.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。機械で試さず、この状態で持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 原状保持で担当確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I brought it in this condition without trying it in a machine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask the person responsible to check it in its original condition. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 状態を確認して、今後の扱いをご案内します。ご自身で補修する前に担当へお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll check the condition and explain how to handle it from now on. Please show it to the person responsible before repairing it yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どのような状態でしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 袋の横が破れています。中身を別の容器へ移してから持ってきてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 破損包装からの詰替え持参を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: The side of the bag is torn. Can I transfer the contents to another container before bringing it in?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about bringing the contents in another container because the packaging is damaged. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 購入品と包装を確認する必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: We need to inspect the purchased item and the packaging.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では、包装を捨てずに残します。中身はまだ使っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 包装保存と中身未使用を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I'll keep the packaging instead of throwing it away. I haven't used the contents yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will retain the packaging and that the contents are unused. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家で袋を出した時です。どこで破れたかはわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 発見時点と原因不明を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: When I took the bag out at home. I don't know where it got torn.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish when you discovered it from the unknown cause. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 購入日とレシートも確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll also check the purchase date and receipt.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日です。レシートはあります。破れた場所を写真にも撮ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 購入日レシートと写真記録を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I bought it today. I have the receipt. I'll also take a photo of the torn area.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State the purchase date, the receipt, and the photographic record. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご持参の方法は売場担当からご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: The sales department staff will explain how to bring it in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。自分で詰め替える前に、案内を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 詰替え前の持参案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll listen to the instructions before transferring it myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for instructions on bringing it in before transferring the contents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 包装とレシートを残したままお待ちください。担当へ状態を伝え、持参方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please wait, keeping the packaging and receipt. We'll tell the person responsible about its condition and explain how to bring it in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 清掃活動へ参加されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Will you be taking part in the cleanup?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 少し手伝いたいです。ただ、二十分ほどで帰ります。途中まででもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 短時間だけの清掃参加を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to help a little. But I'll leave in about twenty minutes. Is it all right to help for just part of it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about taking part in the cleanup for only a short time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 時間を担当へ伝えて、できる範囲をご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Tell the person responsible how much time you have and discuss what you can do.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。作業を引き受けてから急にいなくならないよう、先に帰る時刻を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 作業前に退出時刻を伝える意向を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I'll tell them when I'm leaving beforehand so I don't suddenly disappear after taking on a task.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Express your intention to give your departure time before starting work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 道具は受付で貸し出しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Tools are available to borrow at reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 借りたいです。自分の散歩用の袋ではなく、指定の袋を使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 貸出道具と指定袋の利用を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to borrow some. I'll use the designated bags instead of my own walking bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to use the loaned tools and designated bags. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 拾わないで報告する物もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: There are also things you should report instead of picking up.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: その説明を聞きたいです。何でも素手で拾えるとは思っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 拾わず報告する対象の説明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to hear that explanation. I don't assume I can pick everything up with my bare hands.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for an explanation of items to report without picking up. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受付で道具と注意事項をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Reception will explain the tools and precautions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。帰る前に道具を返し、担当へ退出を知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 道具返却と退出報告を約束する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. Before leaving, I'll return the tools and tell the person responsible I'm going.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Promise to return the tools and report your departure. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: まず受付へどうぞ。短時間の参加希望を伝え、説明を受けてからお手伝いください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16206-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please go to reception first. Explain that you would like to help for a short time, and receive the instructions before helping.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 同じ列車に二名様ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Two people on the same train, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: いいえ。行き先は同じですが、私は今日、友人は明日です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同一行先でも利用日が別と訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: No. We're going to the same place, but I'm traveling today and my friend tomorrow.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Correct the assumption: the destination is the same but the travel dates differ. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 日付を分けてお調べします。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。二人分を一つの封筒へ入れると、取り違えそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 日付別の切符管理を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thank you. If both people's tickets go in one envelope, we might mix them up.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to keep tickets organized by date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 切符は日付ごとに分けてお渡しできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can give you the tickets separated by date.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。今日の分だけ私の財布へ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 当日券だけ財布へ入れると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I'll put only today's ticket in my wallet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will put only today's ticket in your wallet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 明日の方の時刻はお決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Has the person traveling tomorrow decided on a time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだです。友人から返事が来ていないので、明日の分は今買いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人時刻未定で翌日購入を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not yet. My friend hasn't replied, so I won't buy tomorrow's ticket now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Put off buying tomorrow's ticket because your friend's travel time is undecided. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、本日分の一名様だけですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then it's just one person for today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。私の出発時刻を選んでから、一枚購入します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人当日一枚に購入を絞る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll choose my departure time and then buy one ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Limit the purchase to your own single ticket for today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 本日分の候補をご案内します。お一人分として日付と時刻をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll show you today's options. Please check the date and time for one person.
